## Summary

Describe the user-facing and maintainer-facing purpose of this change.

## What Changed

- List the main implementation changes.
- Keep this focused on behavior, API, tooling, docs, or packaging impact.

## Why

Explain the problem being solved or the reason for the change.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run build`

List any additional checks, screenshots, or manual verification steps below.

## Migration Impact

- [ ] No public API, config, or CSS namespace change
- [ ] Public API change documented
- [ ] Config migration documented
- [ ] Docs updated
- [ ] Demo or `apitest` updated when relevant

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is intentionally limited
- [ ] Commit history is reviewable
- [ ] New behavior includes tests or a clear reason why not
- [ ] New public behavior is documented
